reasons: The cited text (Vendor may audit at any time without notice with remote access to Customer systems) is squarely in the walk-away zone, so a deviation finding is correct.

The redline reaches the preferred position: once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, independent non-competitor auditor bound by confidentiality, records-only scope, and express removal of direct or remote system access.

The failed 'minimal edit' heuristic (0.857 changed-character ratio) is justified here because the original sentence granted unlimited, unannounced audits with system access and cannot be conformed without substantially rewriting it; no superfluous, unrelated changes were introduced.

Cost allocation is properly omitted from the edit because Section 22.2 already provides Vendor-borne cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, matching the preferred position; the comment accurately says so.
Comment is concise, first-person plural, correctly prefixed, explains the change, cites the playbook rationale, and offers the fifteen-day notice fallback without lecturing.
